mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) has potential ototoxic and nephrotoxic effects; bupropion lowers seizure threshold and may be affected by renal impairment from amikacin-induced nephrotoxicity.
action: Monitor renal function closely during concurrent use; adjust bupropion dosing if amikacin causes significant renal impairment; assess hearing function during aminoglycoside therapy.
